SAMPLE job description written for a practice demo. Not a real job posting, not written by or with N26.

Backend Engineer, N26, Berlin

What you would do
- Build and run backend services for a mobile banking app
- Design APIs used by the mobile apps and by other teams
- Keep services reliable with monitoring, on-call and incident reviews
- Work with product and security colleagues on regulated features

What we look for
- Experience building backend services in Java, Kotlin or a similar language
- SQL databases, REST APIs and message queues
- Testing, code review and safe deployment habits
- Clear communication in English
